steps.label: 桌面 1440 落地页
steps.run: const doc=document.documentElement; const cards=document.querySelectorAll('.module-card').length; const facts=document.querySelectorAll('.landing-facts li').length; return { ok: cards===7 && facts===3 && doc.scrollWidth<=doc.clientWidth+1, detail: 'cards='+cards+' facts='+facts+' scrollW='+doc.scrollWidth+' clientW='+doc.clientWidth }
